finite_goal: One already-open received Next/Menu interaction, one LLM-authored typed plan, current admission, event-only CLEF control, one bound response and matching received UI progress through actual AgentHost
acceptance: Original actual host capability tracer GREEN, not direct helper only
Actual LlmPlanner investigation/structured NEXT and CHOOSE proposals captured and admitted with fresh host observations
CLEF continue/hold/replan controls unchanged intent; no per-tick model or menu authorship
Bound response once and local dispatch outcome distinct from server acceptance; no progress merely from emitting action
Matching newer same-open UI progress, no repeat same UI/unrelated events as success; unsupported input or timeout safe bounded replan
Wait phase survives expected local waiting state without requiring pre-send ready observation; no redispatch
Invalidate all previous NPC intent/phase/queued decision state on client/wire/session binding change including repeated metadata
Default legacy and IDLE/REST plus keepalive/capture/worker cleanup behavior preserved
additional_client_scope: Add local bound-dispatch feedback only if needed by actual host to distinguish source-denied/no request from issued request; preserve perform_native return/signatures and all previous guards
not_authorized: Native sessions, real inference, world/DB effects or provider purchases
completion_bound: A completed candidate must pass received context -> admitted plan -> CLEF -> actual bound dispatch -> received progress. Partial capability-only scaffolding is not activation or completion.
